summary: Click Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) attaching a press release dated September 11, 2026, disclosing that CEO Chan Chun Sing bought 48,200 Class A ordinary shares in the open market at prevailing prices, an aggregate investment of roughly US$49,900, with details in a separate Form 4. The filing also restates the company's organic-growth plan and openness to M&A or cooperation MOUs, targeting about HK$500 million in annual revenue, and notes FY2026 results due October 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation transaction is stated.
